sections.title: charaNam
lyrics: moola poruLum para mOna porulum onrAi mundhi nee mundhi nAn yEndrAdudhE kanda mozhiyum maraiyum
neeLamidar kaiyum nEdumvarai pEN kaiyum nErukku nEr ninrAdudhE kanda nEnjam Anandha kootthAdudhE
mElE yErindha pandhO kOlam kAtti maraiya viNkadhir thannai piditthAdudhE
madhyamakAla sAhithyam - virittha shadai mudi pOna vEn madhiyum meiyyum nadunkuravAhavum
vidhi mahan nAradhan thudhiyinai koodavum miha miha tonnishai pAdavum
thirattinodu Anaka dhundhubhi oru thanattana thanam pOdavum
than kadhir thamadhu sukirthamEna vikirthamida adir peruha thikitha mEna viLai(yAdinAn)
